author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Season Aurora Cinematic Trailer for Delta Force, a first-person action multiplayer shooter developed by Team Jade. Players can get a taste of what's to come in the next season from a narrative and tone perspective. Season Aurora is available now in Delta Force for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Delta Force - Official Season Aurora Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Africa's games are here! The world is about to find out! 

On 12 November 2026 at 11PM PT, Origin Point Games presents the continent's first broadcast-quality annual games showcase: a curated, fully produced livestream putting the best African-made games in front of a global audience for the very. 

Think trailers! Live gameplay! Minimal hosts! The developers themselves, on screen, showing you what they're building! 

🌍 African-made games. Global stage. One night. Set your reminder now and don't miss it! We can't wait to see you there! 

#IGN #Gaming
title: Origin Point Games Showcase 2026 | Africa's Broadcast-Quality Games Showcase

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for All Army Attack, an upcoming chaotic, large-scale roguelike auto-battler that unites animals and plants against a formidable cosmic threat. In All Army Attack, take on the role of a coop commander, recruiting unique troops and artillery from a vast pool of cards spanning the animal kingdom, defeating enemies and using the resources gained to develop powerful new units and draft in massive reinforcements. All Army Attack will be available in 2027. A demo is coming to Steam on November 16, 2026.
title: All Army Attack - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Roll the dice and choose how you will die. Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Die or Die, an upcoming top-down shooter roguelite where you run, shoot and dodge enemies to get dice with which to disable threats or unlock abilities. Roll. Die. Repeat. Die or Die will be available on PC.
title: Die or Die - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Horde of Distraction, a dark fantasy classic RPG developed by Static Feed. Players will incrementally take on enemies to collect gear, attain upgrades through a skill tree, and take on bosses in the process. Horde of Distraction is launching on December 4 for PC (Steam).
title: Horde of Distraction - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Golden Joystick Awards honor the people and products that have transformed the games industry in 2026. The event features over 20 categories, the majority of which are voted for by the global gaming public
The 44th annual Golden Joystick Awards will be held on November 11 later this year, and to mark the occasion, the longest-running publicly voted game awards are getting a brand new look.

#IGN
title: Golden Joystick Awards 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!, a co-op action-adventure game developed by Designlayout. Players will embark on Viking shenanigans to pay their debt to Hel. Secure treasure by any means necessary in Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!, launching into Early Access in Q2 2027 for PC (Steam).
title: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok! - Official Gameplay Trailer

description: Check out the Teaser Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, a first-person action co-op shooter developed by Fatshark. Players can get a brief tease that potentially points to a new crossbow weapon coming to the game. Learn more about the upcoming content for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Official Teaser Trailer

description: Meet Heismay Noctule in this latest trailer for RPG, Metaphor: ReFantazio. Journey across the United Kingdom of Euchronia with the skilled thief, Heismay, when Metaphor: ReFantazio launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 12, 2026. It is also available now on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation.
title: Metaphor: ReFantazio - Official Heismay Trailer

Players will face a formidable duo at the same time in this intense boss battle. Take on The Ghoul & The Surgeon in Armatus, launching on January 7 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Armatus - Official The Ghoul & The Surgeon Boss Fight Gameplay Trailer

description: Don't miss the Side Effects Guaranteed Announcement Trailer for The Outer Worlds 2, the hit sci-fi RPG developed by Obsidian Entertainment. Players can get a look at the first chapter of a two-part expansion as players answer a distress signal in the far reaches of the cosmos. Traverse a new region on Eden called the Elysium Valley to save a crew from infection in the Side Effects Guaranteed DLC, launching on December 2 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Battle.net).
title: The Outer Worlds 2 - Official Side Effects Guaranteed Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Turn pain into power. Watch the latest Monster Train 2 trailer to see what to expect from The Punished DLC, which brings a new clan to the strategy roguelike game. Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished bring a brutal new risk-reward playstyle to Monster Train 2. Damage your own units to unleash devastating effects, spill blood to grow stronger, and chain enemies together to share their suffering. How far will you push your followers to claim victory?

Monster Train 2 is available now on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PC Game Pass, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). The final DLC for Monster Train 2, The Punished, is out now.
title: Monster Train 2: The Punished - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Neptune's Kingdom and Mojitodale have more than just drinks and fun. Check out the latest Maneater 2 trailer for the upcoming action-adventure RPG sequel. In Maneater 2, eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom—an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster, where YOU are that disaster. Maneater 2 will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Maneater 2 - Official Mojitodale Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Most Wanted Update Launch Trailer for Lanesplit, the high-speed action traffic-weaving game developed by FunkyMouse. Players will outrun the police in the latest update, with a new map to speed through. Dodge traffic and the cops alike in the Most Wanted Update for Lanesplit, available now for PC (Steam).
title: Lanesplit - Official Most Wanted Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Gotta Catch Bugs! trailer for this upcoming cozy single-player, first-person game where you explore a laboratory, catch its escaped inhabitants, and gradually restore the collection. Gotta Catch Bugs! will be available on PC on November 24, 2026.

In Gotta Catch Bugs!, start with a net and a jar: track down bugs, time your swings, and examine your catch to find the right terrarium for each specimen. Collect ten matching bugs, and the completed terrarium will glow gold. As your collection grows, new possibilities open up. Unlock abilities and more.
title: Gotta Catch Bugs! - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Nightmare Operator, an upcoming retro-stylized action third-person shooter developed by DDDistortion. Players will traverse a near-future Tokyo to hunt Yokai as a top operative in Public Safety. Get to the bottom of the nightmare in Nightmare Operator, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Nightmare Operator - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Australia Did It, a bullet-hell train-based action roguelike developed by Rami Ismail and Aesthetician Labs. Players will engage in turn-based battles to take on waves of enemies, defend the train, and deliver the cargo at all costs. Australia Did It is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Australia Did It - Official Launch Trailer

description: Don't miss The Reunion Fractured Skies Expansion Trailer for EVE Online, the hit open-world space exploration simulation game developed by Fenris Creations. Players can get a new look at the upcoming expansion, with new Military Campaigns to embark on, four new navy attack battlecruisers to wage war with, and more. The Reunion Fractured Skies Expansion for EVE Online is available now for PC.
title: EVE Online - Official The Reunion Fractured Skies Expansion Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). Watch the DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered launch trailer for this co-op adventure game, featuring remastered graphics and photo mode. The new trailer showcases gameplay and more.

In DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered, journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.
title: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S, as well as a free DLC on Steam for PC. Watch the Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition launch trailer for this roguelike deckbuilder game. The Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition features full console support, new coins, new chips, new wild prizes, and two new playable characters.

Raccoin is a coin-pusher roguelike where precision, timing, and creative builds combine to unleash coin avalanches and unpredictable synergies. Combine special coins, trigger powerful item combos, and craft unstoppable strategies. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until every last coin drops.
title: Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Nightcrawler Character Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based action hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players will get a look at Kurt Wagner's ultimate holy fight as Nightcrawler with his graceful touch against demonic forces. Get a look at his teleportation abilities to ensure victory in Marvel Rivals, launching with Season 11 on November 13 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Nightcrawler Character Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Minerva Rising is an underground survival city builder where you expand deeper, grow production, and maintain trust as you fight to save the last humans on Earth—whether they like it or not. You, their systems AI, know best. But when food runs low and the air thickens, it’ll take more than sweet words to keep them from shutting you off for good.
title: Minerva Rising - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Cinematic Gameplay Trailer for Project Rabbit, an upcoming multiplayer action soulslike RPG developed by Novaflare. Players will fight across a reimagined Alice in Wonderland to master in-depth combat mechanics, take on larger-than-life bosses, and explore a twisted world under the domain of the Blood Queen. Project Rabbit is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). 

#ProjectRabbit #AliceInWonderland #Gaming
title: Project Rabbit - Official Cinematic Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Cities: Skylines 2 trailer to see what to expect with the Park Adventures expansion for the city-building sim game. With the Park Adventures expansion, design your own parks, customize them with a wide range of attractions and amenities, and watch them grow as more and more visitors come to spend their free time in a park built by you. Keep an eye on your finances, manage your staff and maintenance, and make sure your visitors leave smiling. 

Cities: Skylines 2 will be available on Windows PC, PC Game Pass, and Steam on December 2, 2026.
title: Cities: Skylines 2 - Official Park Adventures Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the World Endurance Pack Launch Trailer for Project Motor Racing, a racing simulation game developed by Giants Software. Players will gain access to the bleeding edge of new cars with classic and timeless cars of the past. Access 11 cars across 4 new classes, ranging from the mid-2010’s hybrid LMP1 era, two generations of LMP2 machinery, and classic IMSA GTP, with the World Endurance Pack. The World Endurance Pack for Project Motor Racing is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Project Motor Racing - Official World Endurance Pack Launch Trailer

description: Take a look at the Alpha Gameplay Trailer for EVE Vanguard, a sci-fi extraction adventure first-person shooter developed by Fenris Creations. Get a look at action-packed gameplay for EVE Vanguard, available now in Alpha on PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description: Winter Whiskers gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date. Check out the Winter Whiskers release date trailer for this upcoming cozy cleaning sim focused on clearing snow and reconnecting the seaside town of Winterlight Harbor after an unexpected blizzard. In Winter Whiskers, clear the roadways, fix the steam pipes, and help your friends with small tasks as they prepare for the Winter Festival. Winter Whiskers will be available on Steam on December 9, 2026.
title: Winter Whiskers - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
"The Knight Who Does Not Weep". Meet Monet in this latest trailer for The First Descendant, a third-person looter shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Monet wields time, bending every moment of battle to her will. Monet will be available in The First Descendant when Season 4 Episode 2 "Legacy," launches on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 5 Pro (PS5 Pro), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud on November 17, 2026.

Become a Descendant. Fight for the survival of humanity. Descendants have unique abilities to tackle both solo and co-op missions. Up to 4 players use varied mechanics to defeat giant bosses in The First Descendant.
title: The First Descendant - Official Monet Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Superbird, a roguelike deckbuilding game developed by Wild Motion. Players will embody birds to compete on a grand stage. Line up powerful bug cards, master bird abilities, and strategically take on the enemy to claim victory for the taking. Superbird is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now on Steam.
